description.value: The Saturna Recreation and Cultural Centre is the community hub of Saturna Island, one of BC's most remote and crowd-free southern Gulf Islands, home to just 350 full-time residents. The facility features an auditorium/gym holding up to 300 people with a performance stage, a fully equipped industrial kitchen, a fitness and weight room, and a lounge. Cyclists ferrying to Saturna Island from Vancouver or Victoria can tap into the centre's year-round recreational, arts, and cultural programming open to all visitors.
